title: SN Sexual History
tagline: Every OStim or SexLab scene becomes a memory for everyone who took part.
description: Prompt for SN_SexualHistory. When an OStim or SexLab scene ends, SN_SexualHistory.dll gathers who took part, the place, the animations played, who climaxed, the SkyrimNet events recorded during the scene and each participant's relevant memories, and sends them with the sn_sexual_history_memory prompt once for every participant, the player included. The answer is stored as that participant's memory.
author: nightlantern-mods
